options.en: The descendants of French colonists who began settling the Maritime provinces in 1604.
options.fr: Les descendants des colons français qui ont commencé à s'établir dans les provinces maritimes en 1604.

options.en: The descendants of British settlers in Newfoundland.
options.fr: Les descendants des colons britanniques de Terre-Neuve.

options.en: The French-speaking people of Quebec City.
options.fr: Les francophones de la ville de Québec.

options.en: The descendants of the first settlers of Upper Canada.
options.fr: Les descendants des premiers colons du Haut-Canada.

explanation.en: Acadians are descended from settlers who came here from France. Their first settlement dates to 1604, in the region we call the Maritimes today. They are a separate people from the Quebecers, with their own story.
explanation.fr: Les Acadiens descendent de colons venus de France. Leur premier établissement date de 1604, dans la région qu'on appelle aujourd'hui les Maritimes. Ils forment un peuple distinct des Québécois, avec leur propre histoire.

source.quote: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.

verification.evidence: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.
